steps.title: Solution
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&\{a,b\}\text{ is a set with }\textcolor{#047857}{\textbf{two}}\text{ elements:}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{a and b. So }n(\{a,b\})=2.\\[5pt]&\{\{a,b\}\}\text{ is a set with }\textcolor{#047857}{\textbf{one}}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{element: the set }\{a,b\}\text{ itself. So}\\[5pt]&\quad n(\{\{a,b\}\})=1.\\[5pt]&\therefore \{a,b\}\ne \{\{a,b\}\}.\text{ For example, }a\in \\[5pt]&\quad \{a,b\},\text{ but }a\notin \{\{a,b\}\};\text{ whereas}\\[5pt]&\quad \{a,b\}\in \{\{a,b\}\}.\end{aligned}\]
